title: Gallery: Bristol Zombie Walk 2015
content:
31st October 2015

Beginning back in 2006, Bristol’s zombie walk tradition has now reached a popularity whereby over a thousand people are expected to take part each year. Taking to the streets of our fair city in a 1.5 mile route, this Halloween saw Bristol city centre invaded by the walking dead in a spectacular parade of macabre make-up and ghoulish costumes.

Our photographer Stef Formica bravely ventured amongst the undead and following a brutal attack that resulted in her brain being devoured by a zombie Maggie Thatcher, these images were found on her camera…
